prompt:
Generate one square transparent production game inventory atlas for KONGTONG martial sect. Sixteen separate hand-painted inventory icons in a precise invisible 4x4 equal-cell layout. STRICT CENTERS: x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% and y=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Each object or explicitly specified set is SMALL, occupying only 50–60% of its cell width and height, giving broad completely transparent margins. All sixteen icons must be isolated, separated by generous transparent horizontal and vertical strips. Nothing touches the canvas edges or crosses any cell boundary. NO text, NO letters, NO writing, NO labels, NO digits, NO visible grid, NO frame, NO background, NO glow. Manuscripts use only tiny pictorial geometric motifs, blank pages with diagrams, never script. Hand-painted chibi wuxia props, watercolor/gouache texture, fine warm brown outlines, soft upper-left lighting, 3/4 top-down view. Color identity: rust red, muted stone gray, warm ivory paper and aged bronze. Distinct binding and silhouette for each manuscript; do not make identical recolored books. Consistent visual weight. Output only the atlas on real transparent alpha.
Place the following in strict row-major order; numbers are instructions only, never draw them:
1. Slim stone-gray rough-paper fist manual, rust-red stitching, square doorway and fist emblem.
2. Rust-red accordion combat diagram with stone-gray cloth spine and circular black shoulder-elbow paths.
3. Thick stone-gray hardbound manual, rust-red metal corners, inset diagonal cracked-stone motif.
4. Paired stone-gray folded leaves tied with rust-red cord, crossed short-blade and hand silhouettes.
5. Small booklet of stone-gray wooden slats threaded with rust-red cord, stable foot silhouettes on the end slat.
6. Rust-red cloth book with wide stone-gray page margins and evenly spaced bronze rings along the spine.
7. Double stone-gray book wrapper around a rust-red volume, central bronze clasp shaped like folded short blades.
8. Stone-gray folded footwork chart on rust-red cloth backing, compact black footprints and a small pebble weight.
9. Four overlapping stone-gray instruction slips, rust-red directional tabs and a bronze corner clip.
10. Dusty stone-gray training journal bound with rust-red strap, a worn short bamboo gauge tucked across the cover.
11. Short blunt square-ridged iron truncheon, stone-gray finish, rust-red leather grip and round bronze guard.
12. Crossed compact stone-gray hook weapons, thick inner hand rings, short outer curves and rust-red wraps.
13. Stone-gray short martial jacket, rust-red sleeve ties and belt, square leather elbow reinforcement.
14. Square aged bronze token with a stone-gray doorway motif, rust-red cord and three shallow tally grooves.
15. Flat stone-gray ceramic balm pot sealed with rust-red paper, folded coarse hand wraps beside it.
16. Five fan-arranged stone-gray rubbings in a rust-red cloth roll, forming a circular stone-gate seal.
visual_review: 已以 view_image 逐格目視核對16件；劍法可辨直劍／劍路，拳掌可辨握拳／開掌，內功可辨冥想／經脈循環，輕功可辨足印／騰躍。秘籍為矩形書冊或矩形卷軸，兵器與服飾信物類型一致。全圖保留4×4原順序、完整剪影及寬透明間隔，無可讀文字、扇形秘籍或裁切。
revision_prompt:
Edit this exact transparent 4 by 4 wuxia inventory atlas, preserving all sixteen item positions and row-major order. The goal is accurate, instantly recognizable inventory thumbnails; martial-arts manuals MUST look like bound rectangular books or rectangular scrolls, never handheld fans or unrelated props. Keep hand-painted gouache fantasy game icon style, fine brown outlines, 3/4 top-down view and original palette. Every object must occupy at most 70% of its equal-size cell with broad fully transparent padding on all four sides, complete silhouettes, clear horizontal and vertical transparent gutters, and no overlap or clipped edges. Keep icon centers x/y at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Preserve correct object designs except uniformly reducing size to fit these margins. No readable text, lettering, labels, digits, grid, borders, or background; only simple meaningful pictorial cover art. Transparent alpha output.
KONGTONG palette: stone gray, rust-red cloth, aged bronze and ivory. EXACT CONTENTS BY ROW/COLUMN:
R1C1 KT001 Rectangular gray paper book with red stitching: replace fist/doorway cover emblem with a large OPEN PALM silhouette and a small curling dragon-shaped flourish, making Dragon Palm manual immediately recognizable. No clenched fist.
R1C2 KT002 Replace tall accordion poses with a rectangular open gray-and-red book showing two LARGE open-palm silhouettes, a small palm-strike practitioner, and upward curved palm-motion arrows. Palm-strike manual, not sword or dance.
R1C3 KT003 Gray hardbound book with red metal corners: remove cracked-stone inset. Add one large powerful CLENCHED FIST icon surrounded by seven short radiating impact strokes and a tiny torso outline. Seven Injuries Fist manual must unmistakably show fist martial arts.
R1C4 KT004 Keep the gray rectangular folded-leaf sword book with crossed rust-red cord, one straight jian silhouette and sword-practice figures. Already correct.
R2C1 KT005 Replace the wooden slat/footprint prop entirely with a rectangular gray bound inner-energy book with red cord spine. Show a seated meditating person and a clear circular breathing arrow from chest to abdomen. Absolutely no footprints.
R2C2 KT006 Rust-red book with bronze binding rings: add a large front-view human torso meridian diagram with thin gold/gray energy-flow lines and small star points at the meridians. Must read as an inner-energy manual rather than a blank book.
R2C3 KT007 Gray-wrapper/red inner-energy book: REMOVE blade-shaped clasp and all weapon motifs. Use a modest plain clasp and a large two-ring circular energy-flow diagram around a seated meditating figure on the cover.
R2C4 KT008 Keep the open rectangular gray/red cloth-backed footwork chart with black footprints and small pebble weight.
R3C1 KT009 Replace loose overlapping instruction cards with a rectangular open gray book, red spine, displaying a clearly leaping person, small cloud curls and sequential footprints with direction arrows. Clearly lightness/footwork book.
R3C2 KT010 Keep gray training journal with rust-red strap and short bamboo ruler; add a small palm-practice pose diagram to visible cover, avoiding readable writing.
R3C3 KT011 Keep blunt squared iron short truncheon with red grip and bronze guard; no sharpened blade.
R3C4 KT012 Keep the two hooked hand-ring weapons with rust-red grips, recognizable as paired hooks.
R4C1 KT013 Keep gray martial jacket with red cuffs and belt.
R4C2 KT014 Keep rectangular bronze disciple token with red cord.
R4C3 KT015 Keep gray ceramic ointment pot with red paper cover and folded handwraps.
R4C4 KT016 Replace fan-arranged stone-gate rubbings with a neat rectangular layered stack of gray rubbing sheets partly unrolled from a red cloth document wrap; visible sheet has clear palm and fist practice diagrams, no circular blank gate seal, no handheld fan geometry.

FINAL LAYOUT PASS:
LAYOUT CORRECTION ONLY. Edit this transparent 4x4 inventory atlas. Keep all SIXTEEN item designs, all meaningful cover pictograms and exact row-major item order unchanged. The existing icons are TOO BIG. Redraw each entire item at only 60% of its current linear size, individually, placing it at the CENTER of its own equal square cell. This means every item silhouette must fit comfortably within the middle 55% of its cell width AND height. IMPORTANT: Shrink the entire heavy sword/scabbard set as well; shrink the entire open-book spread as one item. Give each item very broad empty transparent padding around all four sides. There must be uninterrupted wide transparent horizontal and vertical gutter bands at the quarter, half and three-quarter divisions. Exact equal grid centers: x and y 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%. Preserve the books' sword/palm/fist/meditation/footstep diagrams, weapons, garments, tokens, supplies, boxes, colors and hand-painted gouache texture. No objects may extend beyond their cell. Do not crop, omit, substitute, merge or add items. No readable text, no labels, no visible grid. Return the entire square atlas with real transparent alpha. Again: substantially SMALLER isolated icons, not large icons filling their cells.
